description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1778 round 3, erfc-probes): where does ERFC.PRECISE(x) become 0 (subnormal flush of the result, or an x / z threshold such as sqrt(MAXLOG) = 26.64)? Rows 1-76: x = 26.50 + 0.002k (k = 0..75); rows 77-1077: x = 26.50 + 0.0001k + 6.18E-7 (k = 0..1000). A = x, B = ERFC.PRECISE(x), C = EXP(-(x*x)), D = CHISQ.DIST.RT(2*x*x,1), E = NORM.S.DIST(-x*SQRT(2),TRUE), F = x*x.
